title: ChainstackNode
description: Schema for a Chainstack-managed blockchain node as exposed by the Platform API.

protocol.description: Blockchain protocol (e.g. ethereum, solana, bitcoin, bnb, polygon, arbitrum, base, optimism, avalanche, ton, sui, tron, starknet, zksync, hyperliquid).

network.description: Network ID this node serves (e.g. ethereum-mainnet, polygon-amoy, solana-devnet).

details.description: Per-protocol node details including HTTPS RPC URL, WSS URL, and any chain-specific properties.

client.description: Underlying node client (e.g. geth, erigon, nethermind, reth, solana-validator, bitcoin-core).

archive.description: Whether this node serves archive (historical state) requests.

extra_namespaces.description: Extended namespaces enabled on this node (e.g. debug, trace, txpool).

configuration.description: Deployment configuration (machine size, archive add-on, MEV protection, etc.).
